Wally Jewell will have the sympathy and congratulations of all members on his recent "incident." To have an H.E. with a D.A. right through one's house, burying itself 20 feet in the foundations, whilst still in it, and get away with it is indeed a most miraculous experience.
We are indebted to our old friend Wally Jewell for the results of the Southern Counties Races.
